Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000701" [decision]: The billing API gates the new invoice flow behind feature-flags, because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch.  (about: billing API, feature-flags, new invoice flow)
- memory_id "1000619": feature-flags saw 40,000 requests per second at peak, and most of them were identical.  (about: feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000615" [decision]: As of 2025-09-02, clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds.  (about: feature-flags, clients)
- memory_id "1000362": feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: feature-flags, Tuesday's deploy)
- memory_id "1000180": The job scheduler depends on feature-flags for per-job kill switches.  (about: feature-flags, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000043": feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000650": On 2025-09-16, the Ember team handed the authentication gateway over to the Cinder team.  (about: Cinder team, Ember team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000723": From 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings the Cinder team instead of the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000667": As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler; team Dune owned it until then.  (about: Cinder team, team Dune, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000706": The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.  (about: Atlas team)
- memory_id "1000660": As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler, which team Dune owned until then.  (about: Cinder team, team Dune, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000526" [decision]: From 2025-06-09, the billing API is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, billing API)
- memory_id "1000555": As of 2025-07-30, the Atlas team consists of Priya Raman, after Tomasz left the team.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000742": On 2025-10-15, the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the image resizer's owners.  (about: Atlas team, image resizer, the marketing send)
- memory_id "1000664": As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team.  (about: Cinder team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000261" [decision]: Lena takes over the pager rotation for the Boreal team from Marcus in the cycle starting 2025-03-17.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000448" [decision]: The Ember team decided that the job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node.  (about: Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000567": As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman holds the Atlas team pager instead of Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000751" [decision]: As of 2025-10-24, Diego is on call for the Cinder team this cycle, taking over from Yuki Tanaka.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder team, Diego)
- memory_id "1000502": As of 2025-06-11, team Dune owns the notifier, which the Boreal team owned until then.  (about: Boreal team, team Dune, notifier)
- memory_id "1000551": Tomasz left the Atlas team and joined team Dune on 2025-07-30.  (about: Atlas team, Tomasz, team Dune)
- memory_id "1000454": On 2025-06-09, Oskar wrote the billing API handover document for Lena.  (about: Lena, billing API, Oskar)
